answer: A numbered yarrow stem is pressed into a herbarium sheet at the inlet; wandering the inlet path is the proof. The holder wanders the path once, picks one stem, presses it into the sheet and photographs it with the date. Two verifiers visit in 24 hours and match stem and number; a stem never pressed there, or a duplicate number, locks the account and burns its deposit. One walk is cheap, but 100 fakes need 100 stems and 100 trips to the inlet.
